title: Readable Markdown links across chat, alerts and plans
changes: Shared Markdown and plan anchors use the existing link role and a permanent underline.
Existing Light+ link role is #005A99 and Solarized Light is #005A88 so links also pass on all five single-alert tints.
A focused palette contract covers the five shipped10% alert tints on every supported neutral Markdown host surface.

captureScope.method: Real control-openhands Chrome interactions and computed rendered CSS. Ancestor backgrounds composite in-browser using canvas, then WCAG relative luminance contrast. Alpha byte rounding may differ slightly from ideal palette arithmetic.

fixtureScope: Generated public example.com QA Markdown was sent through the real composer in a real LocalWorkspace conversation. A generated PLAN.md was read through the actual Planner tab. A dummy profile points only to nonworking127.0.0.1:9; the real model request fails with execution_status error. No external model access, tool actions, synthetic events, mocked live API, frontend state injection or secret lookup.
scopeLimits: Measured links only. Existing alert title, icon, body and border styling is unchanged and this is not an accessibility claim for the whole alert.
Single supported alert tints are covered; arbitrary nested alert compositions are not claimed.
The final exact-head packet uses real user-chat content and file-backed Plan content. Earlier ordinary agent/Plan evidence from the root is complementary, not substituted for this new-head proof.

verification.tddRed: The composite contract failed for both light palettes at previousHead.
